1.1: Marot negaim shenayim shehen arbaa. baheret azza chashsheleg, sheniyya lah kesid hahechol. vehasseet kikrum betza, sheniyya lah ketzemer lavan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hasseet ketzemer lavan, sheniyya lah kikrum betza:
1.2: Happatuch shebbashsheleg, keyayin hammazug beshaleg, happatuch shebbassid, kedam hammazug bechalav, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, adamdam shebbaze veshebbaze, keyayin hammazug bemayim, ella shel sheleg azza veshel sid deha mimmenna:
1.3: Arbaa marot haellu mitztarfin ze im ze liftor, ulehachlit, ulehasgir. lehasegir et haomed besof shavua rishon. liftor et haomed besof shavua sheni. lehachelit et shennolad lo michya o sear lavan, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. lehachelit et shennolad lo fisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. lehachelit et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch happetur. liftor et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch hechlet o mittoch hesger. ellu marot negaim shekkol negaim teluyim bahen:
1.4: Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, marot negaim shishsha asar. rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer, marot negaim sheloshim veshishsha. akavya ven mahalalel omer, shivim ushenayim. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, en roim et hannegaim battechilla leachar hashshabbat, sheshshavua shello chal lihyot beshabbat. velo vashsheni, sheshshavua sheni shello chal lihyot beshabbat. velo vashshelishi labbattim, sheshshavua shelishi shello chal lihyot beshabbat. rabbi akiva omer, leolam roim. chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat, maavirin leachar hashshabbat. veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachmir:
1.5: Ketzad lehakel. haya vo sear lavan vehalach lo sear lavan, hayu levanot vehishchiru, achat levana veachat shechora, vehishchiru shetehen, arukkot vehiktziru, achat arukka veachat ketzara vehiktziru shetehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, o chillekan hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak, hayta vo michya vehalcha lah hammichya, hayta merubbaat venaaset agulla o arukka, mevutztzeret venaaset min hatztzad, mechunneset venitpazzera, uva hashshechin venichnas betochah. hikkifah, chillekah, o miatah hashshechin o michyat hashshechin, vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak, haya vo fisyon vehalach lo fisyon, o shehalcha lah haom o shennitmaata veen baze uvaze chaggeris, hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak cholkin ben haom lappisyon, hare ellu lehakel:
1.6: Ketzad lehachemir. lo haya vo sear lavan venolad lo sear lavan, hayu shechorot vehilbinu, achat shechora veachat levana vehilbinu shetehen, ketzarot veheerichu, achat ketzara veachat arukka veheerichu shetehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin et shetehen o et achat mehen, o chilleko hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak vehalchu lahem, lo hayta vo michya venolda lo michya, hayta agulla o arukka venaaset merubbaat, min hatztzad venaaset mevutztzeret, mefuzzeret venitkannesa uva hashshechin venichnas betochah, hikkifah, chillekah, o miatah hashshechin o michyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak vehalchu lahen, lo haya vo fisyon venolad bo fisyon, hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak cholkin ben haom lappisyon vehalchu lahen, hare ellu lehachemir:

2.1: Baheret azza niret baggermani keha, vehakkeha vakkushi azza. rabbi yishmael omer, bene yisrael, ani chapparatan, hare hen keeshkeroa, lo shechorim velo levanim, ella venoniyyim. rabbi akiva omer, yesh latztzayyarim sammanin shehen tzarin tzurot shechorot, levanot uvenoniyyot. mevi sam benoni umakkifo mibbachutz, veterae vabbenoni. rabbi yehuda omer, marot negaim lehakel aval lo lehachemir, yerae haggermani bivsaro lehakel, vehakkushi babbenoni lehakel. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze babbenoni:
2.2: En roim hannegaim bashshacharit uven haarbayim, velo vetoch habbayit, velo vayyom hameunnan, lefi shehakkeha niret azza. velo vatztzohorayim, lefi sheazza niret keha. ematay roin. beshalosh, bearba, uvechamesh, uvesheva, uvishmone, uvetesha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, bearba, bechamesh, bishmone, uvetesha:
2.3: Kohen hassuma veachat meenav, o shekkaha meor enav, lo yire et hannegaim, shenneemar (Vayikra 13), lechol mare ene hakkohen. bayit haafel, en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo:
2.4: Ketzad reiyyat hannega. haish nire cheoder, uchemosek zetim. haishsha keorechet uchemenika et benah, keoreget beomdin lashshechi layyad hayemanit. rabbi yehuda omer, af ketova vefishtan lassemalit. keshem shennire lenigo, kach hu nire letiglachto:
2.5: Kol hannegaim adam roe, chutz minnige atzmo. rabbi meir omer, af lo nige kerovav. kol hannedarim adam mattir, chutz minnidre atzmo. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo nidre ishto shebbenah leven acherim. kol habbechorot adam roe, chutz mibbechorot atzmo:

3.1: Hakkol mittammein bannegaim, chutz min hannachrim veger toshav. hakkol kesherim lirot et hannegaim, ella shehattuma vehattohora vide chohen. omrim lo emor tame, vehu omer tame. emor tahor, vehu omer tahor. en roim shene negaim keechad, ben beish echad uven bishne anashim, ella roe et haechad umasgiro umachlito ufotro, vechozer lashsheni. en masgirin et hammusgar velo machlitin et hammuchlat. en masgirin et hammuchlat, velo machlitin et hammusgar. aval battechilla, besof shavua, hammasgir masgir, vehammachlit machlit, masgir ufoter, machlit ufoter:
3.2: Chatan shennira vo nega, notnin lo shivat yeme hammishte, lo uleveto velichsuto. vechen baregel, notnin lo chol yemot haragel:
3.3: Or habbasar mittamme vishne shavuot uvishlosha simanin, besear lavan uvemichya uvefisyon. besear lavan uvemichya, battechilla, uvesof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittamme vishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom:
3.4: Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad uvishne simanin, besear lavan uvefisyon. besear lavan, battechilla, besof shavua, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua, leachar happetur. umittammein beshavua echad, shehu shivat yamim:
3.5: Hannetakin mittammein bishne shavuot, bishne simanin, besear tzahov dak uvefisyon. besear tzahov dak, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittammein bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom:
3.6: Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat mittammeot bishne shavuot, uvishne simanin, bemichya uvefisyon. bemichya, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, uleachar happetur. umittammeot bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom:
3.7: Habbegadim mittammeim bishne shavuot uvishlosha simanin, birakrak uvaadamdam uvefisyon. birakrak uvaadamdam, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittammein bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom:
3.8: Habbattim mittammein bishlosha shavuot uvishlosha simanim, birakrak uvaadamdam uvefisyon. birakrak uvaadamdam, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, besof shavua shelishi, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, besof shavua shelishi, leachar happetur. umittammein bishlosha shavuot, shehen tisha asar yom. en bannegaim pachot mishshavua echad, velo yoter al shelosha shavuot:

4.1: Yesh besear lavan ma sheen befisyon, veyesh befisyon ma sheen besear lavan. shessear lavan metamme vattechilla, umetamme vechol mare loven, veen bo siman tohora. yesh befisyon, shehappisyon metamme vechol shehu, umetamme vechol hannegaim, chutz lannega, ma sheen ken besear lavan:
4.2: Yesh bemichya ma sheen befisyon, veyesh befisyon ma sheen bemichya. shehammichya metamma vattechilla, umetamma vechol mare, veen bah siman tohora. yesh befisyon, shehappisyon metamme vechol shehu, umetamme vechol hannegaim, chutz lannega, ma sheen ken bemichya:
4.3: Yesh besear lavan ma sheen bemichya, veyesh bemichya ma sheen besear lavan. shessear lavan metamme vashshechin uvammichva, bimchunnas uvimfuzzar, bimvutztzar veshello vimvutztzar. yesh bemichya, shehammichya metamma vakkarachat uvaggabbachat, hafucha veshello hafucha, umeakkevet et hahofech kullo lavan, umetamma vechol mare, ma sheen ken besear lavan:
4.4: Shete searot, ikkaran mashchir veroshan malbin, tahor. ikkaran malbin veroshan mashchir, tame. kamma yehe vallavnunit, rabbi meir omer, kol shehu. rabbi shimon omer, kede likrotz bezug. hayta achat millematta venechleka milmala vehi niret kishtayim, tahor. baheret uvo sear lavan o sear shachor, tame. en choshshin shemma miet mekom sear shachor et habbaheret, mippene sheen bo mammash:
4.5: Baheret kaggeris vechut yotze mimmenna, im yesh bo rochav shete searot, zokkah lesear lavan ulefisyon, aval lo lemichya. shete veharot vechut yotze mizzo lazo, im yesh bo rochav shete searot, metzarfan. veim lav, en metzarfan:
4.6: Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha vesear lavan betoch hammichya, halcha hammichya, temea mippene sear lavan. halach sear lavan, tame mippene hammichya. rabbi shimon metaher, mippene shello hafachattu habbaheret. baheret, hi umichyatah kaggeris, vesear lavan betoch habbaheret, halcha hammichya, temea mippene sear lavan. halach sear lavan, tame mippene hammichya. rabbi shimon metaher, mippene shello hafachattu vaheret kaggeris. umode, sheim yesh bimkom sear lavan kaggeris, shehu tame:
4.7: Baheret uvah michya ufisyon, halcha hammichya, temea mippene happisyon. halach happisyon, temea mippene hammichya. vechen besear lavan uvefisyon. halcha vechazra vesof shavua, hare hi chemot shehayta. leachar happetur, terae chattechilla. hayta azza venaaset keha, keha venaaset azza, hare hi chemo shehayta, uvilvad shello titmaet mearbaa marot. kansa ufasta, pasta vechansa, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
4.8: Baheret kaggeris ufasta chachatzi geris, vehalach min haom kachatzi geris, rabbi akiva omer, terae vattechilla. vachachamim metaharin:
4.9: Baheret kaggeris ufasta chachatzi geris vaod, vehalach min haom kachatzi geris, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. baheret kaggeris ufasta chaggeris vaod, vehalcha lah haom, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim omrim, terae vattechilla:
4.10: Baheret kaggeris ufasta chaggeris, nolda lappisyon michya o sear lavan, vehalach lah haom, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim omrim, terae vattechilla. baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat, hare zo lehasegir:
4.11: Baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum, nolda vaheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot, hare zo lehachelit, mippene sheamru, im baheret kadma lesear lavan, tame. veim sear lavan kadam levaheret, tahor. veim safek, tame. verabbi yehoshua kiha:

5.1: Kol sefek negaim tahor, chutz mizze, veod acher. veeze, ze mi shehayta vo baheret kaggeris vehisgirah, besof shavua vahare hi kassela, safek shehi hi, safek sheacheret baa tachteha, tame:
5.2: Hechlito vesear lavan, halach sear lavan vechazar sear lavan, vechen bemichya uvefisyon, battechilla ubbesof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemo shehayta. hechlito vemichya, vehalcha hammichya vechazra hammichya. vechen besear lavan uvefisyon, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemo shehayta. hechlito vefisyon, halach happisyon vechazar happisyon. vechen besear lavan, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hi chemot shehayta:
5.3: Sear pekudda, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. eze hu sear pekudda, mi shehayta vo vaheret uvah sear lavan, halcha habbaheret vehinnicha lesear lavan bimkomo vechazra, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani veze shehu tahor. eze hu sear pekudda, mi shehayta vo vaheret kaggeris uvah shete searot, vehalach hemenna chachatzi geris vehinnicho lesear lavan bimkom habbaheret vechazar. amru lo, keshem shebbittelu et divre akavya, af devarecha enan mekuyyamin:
5.4: Kol sefek negaim battechilla tahor, ad shello nizkak letuma. mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze vaheret kaggeris uvaze kassela, besof shavua baze kassela uvaze kassela, veeno yadua beeze mehen pasa, ben beish echad ben bishne anashim, tahor. rabbi akiva omer, beish echad, tame. uvishne anashim, tahor:
5.5: Mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen, baze vaheret kaggeris uvaze kassela, besof shavua baze kassela vaod uvaze kassela vaod, shenehen temein. af al pi shechazru lihyot kassela vechassela, shenehen temein, ad sheyyachzeru lihyot kaggeris. ze hu sheamru, mishshennizkak letuma, sefeko tame:

6.1: Gufah shel baheret, kaggeris hakkilki merubba. mekom haggeris, tesha adashot. mekom adasha, arba searot. nimtzeu sheloshim vashesh searot:
6.2: Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha, ravta habbaheret, temea. nitmaata, tehora. ravta hammichya, temea. nitmaata, tehora:
6.3: Baheret kaggeris uvah michya fechuta mikkaadasha, ravta habbaheret, temea. nitmaata, tehora. ravta hammichya, temea. nitmaata, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharim, sheen hannega pose letochah:
6.4: Baheret yetera mikkaggeris uvah michya yetera mikkaadasha, rabbu o shennitmaatu, temein, uvilvad shello yitmaatu mikkashshiur:
6.5: Baheret kaggeris umichya kaadasha makkaftah vechutz lammichya baheret, happenimit lehasegir, vehachitzona lehachelit. amar rabbi yose, en hammichya siman tuma lachitzona, shehabbaheret letochah. nitmaata vehalcha lah, rabban gamliel omer, im mibbifnim hi chala, siman pisyon lappenimit, vehachitzona tehora. veim mibbachutz, hachitzona tehora vehappenimit lehasegir. rabbi akiva omer, ben kach uven kach, tehora:
6.6: Amar rabbi shimon, ematay, bizman shehi chaadasha muvet. hayta yetera mikkaadasha, hammotar siman pisyon lappenimit, vehachitzona temea. haya vohak pachut mikkaadasha, siman pisyon lappenimit, veen siman pisyon lachitzona:
6.7: Esrim vearbaa rashe evarin baadam sheenan mittammein mishshum michya, rashe etzbeot yadayim veraglayim, verashe aznayim, verosh hachotem, verosh haggeviyya, verashe haddaddim shebbaishsha. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel ish. rabbi eliezer omer, af hayyabbalot vehaddildulin enan mittammein mishshum michya:
6.8: Ellu mekomot baadam sheenan mittammein bevaheret, toch haayin, toch haozen, toch hachotem, toch happe, hakkematin, vehakkematin shebbatztzavvar, tachat haddad, uvet hashshechi, kaf haregel, vehatztzipporen, harosh, vehazzakan, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach hammordin, enan mittammein bannegaim, veenan mitztarfim bannegaim, veen hannega pose letochan, veenan mittammein mishshum michya, veenan meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan. chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim, veenan mitztarfin bannegaim, veen hannega pose letochan, veenan mittammein mishshum michya, aval meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan. harosh vehazzakan ad shello heelu sear, vehaddildulin shebbarosh veshebbazzakan, niddonim keor habbasar:

7.1: Ellu veharot tehorot. shehayu vo kodem lemattan tora, benachri venitgayyer, bekatan venolad, bekemet venigla, barosh uvazzakan, bashshechin uvammichva vekedach uvammordin. chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, tehorim. harosh vehazzakan ad shello heelu sear, heelu sear venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach ad shello naasu tzarevet, naasu tzarevet vechayu, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov metamme, shettechillatan vesofan tame. vachachamim metaharim:
7.2: Nishtannu marehen, ben lehakel ben lehachemir. ketzad lehakel. hayta chashsheleg venaasa chesid hahechol ketzemer lavan vechikrum betza, naaset mispachat seet, o mispachat azza. ketzad lehachemir. hayta chikrum betza venaaset ketzemer lavan kesid hahechol uchesheleg, rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher. rabbi elazar chisma omer, lehakel, tahor, ulehachmir, terae vattechilla. rabbi akiva omer, ben lehakel ben lehachemir, terae vattechilla:
7.3: Baheret veen bah kelum, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, yasgir. besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, yiftor. odehu masgiro ufoter venoldu lo simane tuma, yachlit. baheret uvah simane tuma, yachlit. odehu machlito vehalchu lahen simane tuma, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, yasgir. besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, yiftor:
7.4: Hattolesh simane tuma, vehakkove et hammichya, over belo taase. uletohora, ad shello va etzel hakkohen, tahor. leachar hechleto, tame. amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua holchin legadvad, betoch hesgero, ma hu. amru li, lo shamanu. aval shamanu, ad shello va etzel hakkohen, tahor, leachar hechleto, tame. hitchalti mevi lahem reayot. echad omed bifne hakkohen veechad betoch hesgero, tahor, ad sheyyetammeennu hakkohen. meematay hi tohorato, rabbi eliezer omer, lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu. vachachamim omrim, ad shettifrach bechullo, o ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris:
7.5: Mi shehayta vo vaheret veniktzetza, tehora. ketzatzah mitkavven, rabbi eliezer omer, lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu. vachachamim omrim, ad shettifrach bechullo. hayta verosh haarla, yimmol:

8.1: Happoreach min hattame, tahor. chazru vo rashe evarim, tame, ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris. min hattahor, tame. chazru vo rashe evarim, tame, ad shettachazor bahareto lichmot shehayta:
8.2: Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha, parcha vechullo veachar kach halcha lah hammichya, o shehalcha lah hammichya veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor. nolda lo michya, tame. nolad lo sear lavan, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
8.3: Baheret uvah sear lavan, parcha vechullo, af al pi shessear lavan bimkomo, tahor. baheret uvah pisyon, parcha vechullo, tahor. vechullan shechazru vahen rashe evarim, hare ellu temein. parcha vemiktzato, tame. parcha vechullo, tahor:
8.4: Kol perichat rashe evarim shebbifrichatan tiharu tame, kesheyyachzeru temeim. kol chazirat rashe evarim shebbachaziratam timmeu tahor, nitkassu, tahor. nitgallu, tame, afillu mea feamim:
8.5: Kol harauy littamme venega habbaheret, meakkev et happericha. kol sheeno rauy littamme venega habbaheret, eno meakkev et happericha. ketzad. parcha vechullo, aval lo varosh uvazzakan, bashshechin, bammichva uvakkedach hammordin, chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, tehorim. parcha vechullo, aval lo vechachatzi adasha hassamuch larosh velazzakan, lashshechin, lammichva, velakkedach, chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, af al pi shennaasa mekom hammichya baheret, tame, ad shettifrach bechullo:
8.6: Shete veharot, achat temea veachat tehora, parcha mizzo lazo veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor. bisfato haelyona, bisfato hattachtona, bishte etzbeotav, bishne rise enav, af al pi shemmedubbakim ze laze vehem nirim keechad, tahor. parcha vechullo, aval lo vabbohak, tame. chazru vo rashe evarim kemin bohak, tahor. chazru vo rashe evarim pachot mikkaadasha, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, bohak pachot mikkaadasha, siman tuma vattechilla, veen siman tuma vassof:
8.7: Habba chullo lavan, yasgir. nolad lo sear lavan, yachlit. hishchiru shetehem o achat mehen, hiktziru shetehen o achat mehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin et shetehen o et achat mehen, o chillekan hashshechin umichyat hashshechin hammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak. nolad lo michya o sear lavan, tame. lo nolad lo lo michya velo sear lavan, tahor. vechullan shechazru vahen rashe evarim, hare ellu chemot shehayu. parcha vemiktzato, tame. parcha vechullo, hare hu tahor:
8.8: Im bechullo farcha cheachat, mittoch hattohora, tame. umittoch hattuma, tahor. hattahor mittoch hesger, patur min happeria umin happerima umin hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim. mittoch hechlet, chayyav bechullan. ze vaze metammeim bevia:
8.9: Habba chullo lavan uvo michya chaadasha, parcha vechullo veachar kach chazru vo rashe evarim, rabbi yishmael omer, kachazirat rashe evarim bevaheret gedola. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kachazirat rashe evarim bevaheret ketanna:
8.10: Yesh mare nigo lakkohen veniskar, veyesh mare umafsid. ketzad. mi shehaya muchlat, vehalchu lahen simane tuma, lo hispik lehareotah lakkohen ad shepparcha vechullo, tahor. sheillu hera lakkohen, haya tame. baheret veen bah kelum, lo hispik lehareotah lakkohen ad shepparcha vechullo, tame. sheillu hera lakkohen, haya tahor:

9.1: Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad, bishne simanim, besear lavan uvefisyon. eze hu hashshechin. laka veetz o veeven o vegefet o veme teverya, kol sheeno mechamat haesh, ze hu shechin. ezo hi michva. nichva vegachelet o veremetz, kol shehu mechamat haesh, zo hi michva:
9.2: Hashshechin vehammichva en mitztarfin ze im ze, veen posin mizze laze, veen posin leor habbasar, velo or habbasar pose letochan. hayu mordin, tehorin. asu kerum kiklippat hashshum, zo hi tzarevet hashshechin haamura vattora. chazru vechayu, af al pi shemmekoman tzalleket, niddonin keor habbasar:
9.3: Shaalu et rabbi eliezer, mi shealta letoch yado baheret kassela umekomah tzarevet shechin. amar lahem, yasgir. amru lo, lamma, legaddel sear lavan enah reuya, ulefisyon enah posa, ulemichya enah mittamma. amar lahen, shemma tichnos vetifse. amru lo, vahalo mekomah kaggeris. amar lahen, lo shamati. amar lo rabbi yehuda ven betera, alammed bo. amar lo, im lekayyem divre chachamim, hen. amar lo, shemma yivvaled lo shechin acher chutza lo veyifse letocho. amar lo, chacham gadol atta shekkiyyamta divre chachamim:

10.1: Hannetakim mittammein bishne shavuot, uvishne simanim, besear tzahov dak uvefisyon. besear tzahov dak, lakuy katzar, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, afillu aroch. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma hallashon omrim, dak makkel ze, dak kane ze, dak lakuy katzar, o dak lakuy aroch. amar lo rabbi akiva, ad sheanu lemedim min hakkane, nilmad min hassear. dak searo shel peloni, dak lakuy katzar, lo dak lakuy aroch:
10.2: Sear tzahov dak metamme mechunnas, umefuzzar, umevutztzar, veshello mevutztzar, hafuch, veshello hafuch, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, eno metamme ella hafuch. amar rabbi shimon, vedin hu, ma im sear lavan, sheen sear acher matztzil miyyado, eno metamme ella hafuch. sear tzahov dak shessear acher matztzil miyyado, eno din shello yetamme ella hafuch. rabbi yehuda omer, kol makom shetztzarich lomar hafuch, amar hafuch. aval hannetek shenneemar bo (Vayikra 13) velo haya vo sear tzahov, metamme hafuch veshello hafuch:
10.3: Hatztzomeach matztzil miyyad hassear tzahov umiyyad happisyon, mechunnas, umefuzzar, mevutztzar, veshello mevutztzar. vehameshoar matztzil miyyad sear tzahov umiyyad happisyon, mechunnas, umefuzzar, umevutztzar. veeno matztzil min hatztzad, ad sheyyehe rachok min hakkama mekom shete searot. achat tzehubba veachat shechora, achat tzehubba veachat levana, enan matztzilot:
10.4: Sear tzahov shekkadam et hannetek, tahor. rabbi yehuda metamme. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, lo metamme velo matztzil. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheeno siman tuma vannetek, hare hu siman tohora vannatek:
10.5: Ketzad megallechin et hannetek. megalleach chutza lo umanniach shete searot samuch lo, kede sheyyehe nikkar im pasa. hechlito vesear tzahov, halach sear tzahov vechazar sear tzahov, vechen befisyon, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hu chemot shehaya. hechlito befisyon, vehalach happisyon vechazar happisyon. vechen besear tzahov, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hu chemo shehaya:
10.6: Shene netakim, ze vetzad ze, veshita shel sear mafseket benehem, nifratz mimmakom echad, tame. mishshene mekomot, tahor. kamma tehe happirtza, mekom shete searot. nifratz mimmakom echad kaggeris, tame:
10.7: Shene netakin, ze lifnim mizze, veshita shel sear mafseket benehen, nifratz mimmakom echad, tame. mishshene mekomot, tahor. kamma tehe happirtza, mekom shete searot. nifratz mimmakom echad kaggeris, tahor:
10.8: Mi shehaya vo netek uvo sear tzahov, tame. nolad lo sear shachor, tahor. af al pi shehalach lo sear shachor, tahor. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon, kol netek shettahar shaa achat, en lo tuma leolam. rabbi shimon omer, kol sear tzahov shettahar shaa achat, en lo tuma leolam:
10.9: Mi shehaya vo netek kaggeris, venittak kol rosho, tahor. harosh vehazzakan en meakkevin ze et ze, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, meakkevin ze et ze. amar rabbi shimon, vedin hu, ma im or happanim veor habbasar, sheyyesh davar acher mafsik benehem, meakkevin ze et ze, harosh vehazzakan sheen davar acher mafsik benehem, eno din sheyyeakkevu ze et ze. harosh vehazzakan en mitztarfin ze im ze, veen posin mizze laze. eze hu zakan, min happerek shel lechi ad pikka shel gargaret:
10.10: Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat mittammeot bishne shavuot, bishne simanim, bemichya uvefisyon. ezo hi karachat, achal neshem, sach neshem, makka sheenah reuya legaddel sear. ezo hi karachat, min hakkadkod hashshofea laachorav ad pikka shel tzavvar. ezo hi gabbachat, min hakkadkod hashshofea lefanav ad keneged sear milmalan. hakkarachat vehaggabbachat enan mitztarfot zo im zo, veenan posot mizzo lazo. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh sear benehen, enan mitztarfot. veim lav, hare ellu mitztarfot:

11.1: Kol habbegadim mittammein bannegaim, chutz mishshel nachrim. hallokeach begadim min hannachrim, yerau vattechilla. veorot hayyam enan mittammein bannegaim. chibber lahem min haggadel baaretz, afillu chut, afillu meshicha, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, tame:
11.2: Tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shetterafan ze vaze, im rov min haggemallim, enam mittammein bannegaim. im rov min harchelim, mittammeim bannegaim. mechetza lemechetza, mittammein bannegaim. vechen happishtan vehakkanbos shetterafan ze vaze:
11.3: Haorot vehabbegadim hatztzevuim, en mittammein bannegaim. habbattim, ben tzevuim ben sheenan tzevuim, mittammein bannegaim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, haorot kabbattim. rabbi shimon omer, hatztzevuim bide shamayim, mittammein. uvide adam, enan mittammein:
11.4: Beged sheshshityo tzavua veerbo lavan, erbo tzavua veshityo lavan, hakkol holech achar hannire. habbegadim mittammein birakrak shebbayrukkim, uvaadamdam shebbaadummim. haya yerakrak ufasa adamdam, adamdam ufasa yerakrak, tame. nishtanna ufasa, nishtanna velo fasa, keillu lo nishtanna. rabbi yehuda omer, yerae vattechilla:
11.5: Haomed barishon, yechabbes veyasgir. haomed bashsheni, yissaref. happose vaze uvaze, yissaref. hichha vattechilla, rabbi yishmael omer, yechabbes veyasgir. vachachamim omrim, eno zakuk lo. hichha varishon, yechabbes veyasgir. hichha vashsheni, koro vesoref ma shekkara. vetzarich matlit. rabbi nechemya omer, eno tzarich matlit:
11.6: Chazar nega labbeged, matztzil et hammatlit. chazar lammatlit, soref et habbeged. hattole min hammusgar battahor, chazar nega labbeged, soref et hammatlit. chazar lammatlit, habbeged harishon yissaref, vehammatlit teshammesh et habbeged hashsheni besimanin:
11.7: Kayta sheyyesh bah pispasim tzevuim ulevanim, posin mizze laze. shaalu et rabbi eliezer, vahare hu fispas yachid. amar lahen, lo shamati. amar lo rabbi yehuda ven betera, alammed bo. amar lo, im lekayyem divre chachamim, hen. amar lo, shemma yaamod bo shene shavuot, vehaomed babbegadim shene shavuot tame. amar lo, chacham gadol atta, shekkiyyamta divre chachamim. happisyon hassamuch, kol shehu. harachok, kaggeris. vehachozer, kaggeris:
11.8: Hashsheti vehaerev mittammeim bannegaim miyyad. rabbi yehuda omer, hashsheti, mishsheyyishshalek, vehaerev, miyyad. vehaunin shel pishtan, mishsheyyitlabbenu. kamma yehe vappekaat utehe mittammea vannegaim, kede leerog mimmenna shalosh al shalosh sheti vaerev, afillu chullah sheti, afillu chullah erev. hayta fesikot, enah mittammea vannegaim. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu fesika achat ukesharah, enah mittammea:
11.9: Hammaale min happekaat lachavertah, min hasselil lachavero, min hakkoved haelyona lakkoved hattachtona, vechen shene dappe chaluk shennira nega beachad mehen, hare hashsheni tahor. benefesh hammassechet uvashsheti haomed, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim miyyad. rabbi shimon omer, hashsheti, im haya ratzuf, mittamme:
11.10: Nira bashsheti haomed, haarig tahor. nira vaarig, hashsheti haomed tahor. nira vassadin, soref et hannimin. nira vannimin, hassadin tahor. chaluk shennira vo nega, matztzil et haumriyyot shebbo, afillu hen argaman:
11.11: Kol harauy littamme teme met, af al pi sheeno rauy littamme midras, mittamme vannegaim. kegon kela shel sefina, uvilon, veshavis shel sevacha, umitpachot shel sefarim, vegalgillon, uretzuot minal vesandal sheyyesh bahen rochav kaggeris, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim. sagos shennira vo nega, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ad sheyyerae vaarig uvammochin. hachemet vehatturemal nirin kedarkan, ufose mittocho laachorav umeachorav letocho:
11.12: Beged hammusgar shennitarev baacherim, kullan tehorim. ketzatzo vaasao mochin, tahor, umuttar bahanayato. vehammuchlat shennitarev baacherim, kullam temein. ketzatzo vaasao mochin, tame, veasur bahanayato:

12.1: Kol habbattim mittammein bannegaim, chutz mishshel nachrim. hallokeach battim min hannachrim, yerau vattechilla. bayit agol, bayit terigon, bayit habbanuy bisfina o veaskarya, al arba korot, eno mittamme vannegaim. veim haya merubba, afillu al arbaa ammudim, mittamme:
12.2: Bayit sheachad mitztzedadav mechuppe veshayish, echad besela, veechad bilvenim, veechad beafar, tahor. bayit shello hayu vo avanim veetzim veafar venira vo nega veachar kach heviu vo avanim veetzim veafar, tahor. vechen beged shello arag bo shalosh al shalosh venira vo nega veachar kach arag bo shalosh al shalosh, tahor. en habbayit mittamme vannegaim ad sheyyehe vo avanim veetzim veafar:
12.3: Vechamma avanim yehu vo. rabbi yishmael omer, arba. rabbi akiva omer, shemone. shehaya rabbi yishmael omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim o al even echat. rabbi akiva omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim, lo al even echat. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim bishne chetalim bazzavit, arko kishne gerisin verachbo kaggeris:
12.4: Etzim, kede litten tachat hashshekof. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot sandal laachore hashshekof. afar, kede litten ben patztzim lachavero. kirot haevus, vekirot hammechitztza, enan mittammein bannegaim. yerushalayim vechutza laaretz, enan mittammein bannegaim:
12.5: Ketzad reiyyat habbayit. uva asher lo habbayit vehiggid lakkohen lemor kenega nira li babbayit (Vayikra 14). afillu talmid chacham veyodea shehu nega vadday, lo yigzor veyomar nega nira li babbayit, ella kenega nira li babbayit. vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit (beterem yavo hakkohen lirot et hannega velo yitma kol asher babbayit veachar ken yavo hakkohen lirot et habbayit) (sham), vaafillu chavile etzim, vaafillu chavile kanim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, esek hu lappinnuy. amar rabbi meir, vechi ma mittamme lo. im tomar, kele etzav uvegadav umattechotav, matbilan vehen tehorim. al me chasa hattora. al kele charso veal pakko veal tifyo. im kach chasa hattora al mamono habbazuy, kal vachomer al mamono hechaviv. im kach al mamono, kal vachomer al nefesh banav uvenotav. im kach al shel rasha, kal vachomer al shel tzaddik:
12.6: Eno holech letoch beto umasgir, velo vetoch habbayit shehannega betocho umasgir, ella omed al petach habbayit shehannega betocho umasgir, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), veyatza hakkohen min habbayit el petach habbayit vehisgir et habbayit shivat yamim. uva vesof hashshavua veraa im pasa, vetzivva hakkohen vechilletzu et haavanim asher bahen hannaga vehishlichu ethen el michutz lair el makom tame. velakchu avanim acherot veheviu el tachat haavanim veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit (sham). eno notel avanim mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze, velo afar mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze, velo sid mikkol makom. eno mevi lo achat tachat shetayim velo shetayim tachat achat, ella mevi shetayim tachat shetayim, tachat shalosh, tachat arba. mikkan amru, oy larasha oy lishcheno, shenehen choltzin, shenehen kotzin, shenehen meviin et haavanim. aval hu levaddo mevi et heafar, shenneemar (sham), veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit, en chavero mittappel immo batticha:
12.7: Ba vesof shavua veraa, im chazar, venatatz et habbayit et avanav veet etzav veet kol afar habbayit vehotzi el michutz lair el makom tame (sham). happisyon hassamuch, kol shehu. veharachok, kaggeris. vehachozer babbattim, kishne gerisin:

13.1: Asara vattim hen, hakkehe varishon, vehaholech lo, kolfo vehu tahor. hakkehe vashsheni, vehaholech lo, kolfo vehu taun tzipporim. happose varishon, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. amad barishon ufasa vashsheni, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. amad baze uvaze, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. im ad shello tiharo vatztzipporim nira vo nega, hare ze yinnatetz. veim mishshettiharo vatztzipporim nira vo nega, yerae battechilla:
13.2: Haeven shebbazzavit, bizman shehu choletz, choletz et kullo. uvizman shehu notetz, notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero. nimtza chomer bachalitza mibbannetitza. rabbi elazar omer, bayit habbanuy rosh ufittin, nira varosh, notel et kullo. nira vappittin, notel et shello umanniach et shel chavero:
13.3: Bayit shennira vo nega, hayta aliyya al gabbav, noten et hakkorot laaliyya. nira vaaliyya, noten et hakkorot labbayit. lo hayta aliyya al gabbav, avanav veetzav vaafaro nittatzin immo. umatztzil al hammalbenim, veal serige hachallonot. rabbi yehuda omer, malben habbanuy al gabbav, nittatz immo. avanav veetzav vaafaro metammein bechazzayit, rabbi elazar chisma omer, bema shehen:
13.4: Bayit hammusgar, metamme mittocho. vehammuchlat, mittocho umeachorav. ze vaze metammein bevia:
13.5: Habbone min hammusgar betahor, vechazar nega labbayit, choletz et haavanim. chazar al haavanim, habbayit harishon yinnatetz, vehaavanim yeshammeshu et habbayit hashsheni besimanin:
13.6: Bayit shehu mesech al gabbe vayit hamenugga, vechen ilan shehu mesech al gabbe vayit hamenugga, hannichnas lachitzon, tahor, divre rabbi elazar ben azarya. amar rabbi elazar, ma im even achat mimmennu metamma bevia, hu atzmo lo yetamme bevia:
13.7: Hattame omed tachat hailan vehattahor over, tame. hattahor omed tachat hailan vehattame over, tahor. im amad, tame. vechen beeven hamenuggaat, tahor. veim hinnichah, hare ze tame:
13.8: Tahor shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tame, nitma. vetame shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tahor, timmeahu. tallit tehora shehichnis mimmenna shalosh al shalosh levayit tame, nitmea. utemea shehichnis mimmenna afillu chazzayit levayit tahor, timmeattu:
13.9: Mi shennichnas levayit hamenugga vechelav al ketefo vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav, hu vahen temein miyyad. haya lavush bechelav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beyadav, hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras. pat chittin velo fat seorim, mesev veochlan beliftan:
13.10: Haya omed bifnim ufashat yado lachutz vetabbeotav beyadav, im shaha chede achilat peras, temeot. haya omed bachutz ufashat yado lifnim vetabbeotav beyadav, rabbi yehuda metamme miyyad. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras. amru lo lerabbi yehuda, ma im bizman shekkol gufo tame, lo timme et ma shealav ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras, bizman sheen kol gufo tame, eno din shello yetamme et ma shealav ad sheyyishhe chede achilat peras:
13.11: Metzora shennichnas levayit, kol hakkelim sheyyesh sham temein, afillu ad hakkorot. rabbi shimon omer, ad arba ammot. kelim, miyyad temein. rabbi yehuda omer, im shaha chede hadelakat hanner:
13.12: Nichnas levet hakkeneset, osim lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim al rochav arba ammot. nichnas rishon, veyotze acharon. kol hammatztzil tzamid patil beohel hammet, matztzil tzamid patil bevayit hamenugga. vechol hammatztzil mechusse veohel hammet, matztzil mechusse bevayit hamenugga, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kol hammatztzil tzamid patil beohel hammet, matztzil mechusse bevayit hamenugga. kol hammatztzil mechusse veohel hammet, afillu megulle bevayit hamenugga, tahor:

14.1: Ketzad metaharin et hammetzora. haya mevi feyali shel cheres chadasha venoten letochah reviit mayim chayyim, umevi shete tzipporim deror. shachat et achat mehen al keli cheres veal mayim chayyim. chafar vekovrah befanav. natal etz erez veezov usheni tolaat ucherachan bishyare hallashon, vehikkif lahem rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav shel sheniyya. taval vehizza sheva peamim leachar yado shel metzora, veyesh omrim, al mitzcho. vechach haya mazze al hashshekof shebbabbayit mibbachutz:
14.2: Ba lo leshalleach et hatztzippor hachayya, eno hofech panav lo layyam velo lair velo lammidbar, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), veshillach et hatztzippor hachayya el michutz lair el pene hassade. ba legalleach et hammetzora, heevir taar al kol besaro, vechibbes begadav, vetaval, tahor milletamme bevia, vahare hu metamme chashsheretz. nichnas lifnim min hachoma, menudde mibbeto shivat yamim, veasur betashmish hammitta:
14.3: Bayyom hashshevii megalleach tiglachat sheniyya kattiglachat harishona, kibbes begadav vetaval, tahor milletamme chashsheretz, vahare hu tevul yom, ochel bammaaser. heeriv shimsho, ochel batteruma. hevi chapparato, ochel bakkadashim. nimtzeu shalosh teharot bammetzora veshalosh teharot bayyoledet:
14.4: Shelosha megallechin vetiglachtan mitzva, hannazir vehammetzora vehaleviyyim. vechullan sheggillechu shello vetaar o sheshshiyyeru shete searot, lo asu chelum:
14.5: Shete tzipporim mitzvatan sheyyehu shavot bammare uvakkoma uvaddamim, ulekichatan keechat. af al pi sheenam shavot, kesherot. lakach achat hayyom veachat lemachar, kesherot. shachat achat mehen venimtzet shello deror, yikkach zug lashsheniyya. harishona mutteret baachila. shechatah venimtzet terefa, yikkach zug lashsheniyya. harishona mutteret bahanaa. nishpach haddam, tamut hammishtallachat. meta hammishtallachat, yishshafech haddam:
14.6: Mitzvat etz erez, arko amma veavyo chirvia kera hammitta. echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa. mitzvat ezov, lo ezov yavan, lo ezov kochali, lo ezov romi, lo ezov midbarit, velo chol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay:
14.7: Bayyom hashshemini mevi shalosh behemot, chattat veasham veola. vehaddal haya mevi chattat haof veolat haof:
14.8: Ba lo etzel haasham, vesamach shete yadav alav, ushechato, vekibbelu shene chohanim et damo, echad bichli, veechad bayyad. ze shekkibbel bakkeli, ba uzerako al kir hammizbeach. veze shekkibbel bayyad, ba lo etzel hammetzora. vehammetzora taval belishkat hammetzoraim. ba veamad beshaar nikkanor. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya tzarich tevila:
14.9: Hichnis rosho, venatan al tenuch azno. yado, venatan al bohen yado. raglo, venatan al bohen raglo. rabbi yehuda omer, shelashtam haya machnis keechad. en lo bohen yad, bohen regel, ozen yemanit, en lo tohora olamit. rabbi eliezer omer, noten hu al mekoman. rabbi shimon omer, im natan al shel semol, yatza:
14.10: Natal millog hashshemen veyatzak letoch kappo shel chavero. veim yatzak letoch kaf atzmo, yatza. taval vehizza sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakkodashim, al kol hazzaya tevila. ba lo etzel hammetzora, mekom shehu noten et haddam, sham hu noten et hashshemen, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), al mekom dam haasham. vehannotar min hashshemen asher al kaf hakkohen yitten al rosh hammittaher lechapper. im natan, kipper. veim lo natan, lo chipper, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, sheyare mitzva hen, ben shennatan ben shello natan, kipper, umaalin alav keillu lo chipper. chasar hallog ad shello yatzak, yemalennu. mishsheyyatzak, yavi acher battechilla, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, chasar hallog ad shello natan, yemalennu. mishshennatan, yavi acher battechilla:
14.11: Metzora shehevi karbano ani veheeshir, o ashir veheeni, hakkol holech achar chattat, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer, achar haasham:
14.12: Metzora ani shehevi karban ashir, yatza. veashir shehevi karban ani, lo yatza. mevi adam al yede veno, al yede vitto, al yede avdo veshifchato karban ani, umaachilan bazzevachim. rabbi yehuda omer, af al yede ishto mevi karban ashir, vechen kol karban shehi chayyavet:
14.13: Shene metzoraim shennitarvu karbenotehem, karav karbano shel achad mehem, umet achad mehem, zo sheshshaalu anshe alekkesanderiyya et rabbi yehoshua. amar lahem, yichtov nechasav leacher veyavi karban ani:
